info.name: RingCentral Adaptive Cards Compliance Exports API

params.name: status
params.description: Status of the task(s) to be returned. Multiple values are supported

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to be retrieved; value range is > 0

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of records to be returned per page; value range is 1 - 250

items.docs: Returns the list of Glip data export tasks.

Creates a task for Glip data export and returns a link at which the exported data will be available in future once the task is implemented. The exported data can be downloaded by calling Get Data Export Task method with the specified task ID. Simultaneously no more than 2 tasks per company can be created.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Internal identifier of a task to be retrieved

items.docs: Returns the links for downloading Glip data exported within the specified task. If the export task is still in progress, then only the task status will be returned. If the data is ready for downloading, then the list of URLs will be returned.
